# Generated by the Lucidity orchestrator — do not hand-edit for production.

The orchestrator writes:

- `*.yaml` — normalized inventory (provider-neutral)
- `*.ini` — Ansible inventory (SSM connection vars for AWS)
- `*.json` — summary for humans / CI artifacts

## Generate (dry-run, no AWS needed)

```bash
cd /path/to/repo
python3 -m orchestrator \
  --cloud aws \
  --customer nike \
  --account 111111111111 \
  --environment prod \
  --region us-east-1 \
  --dry-run
```

## Use with Ansible

```bash
cd ansible
ansible-playbook -i inventory/generated/<file>.ini playbooks/enroll.yml -v
```

Files matching `*` are gitignored except this README.
